newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Sudisa says '96 exports will top $9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Sudisa says '96 exports will top $9 mln.

text.p: Truck axle manufacturer Super Diesel (Sudisa) sales will total $18 million in 1996, of which it will export 54-55 percent, the company director general said.

These figures compared favorably with total sales of $10 million in 1995 and exports of $5 million, said Octavio Rubio Hernandez in a telephone interview. Sudisa is a subsidiary of Dirona, based in Monterrey, Mexico, which in turn is a partner of Rotwell International in Michigan, U.S.A.
